MORE:
The Board of Directors in their meeting held on 14.11.2026 Approved and took on record the Unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026, Approved the appointment of Mrs. Khadija Taher Raniwala (DIN 11237433) and Mrs. Usha Ghelani (DIN 10414386) as Non Executive Independent Director and Further approved the resignation of Mrs. V. Mythili (DIN 08113494)Non Executive Independent Director with effect from 14.11.2026.
The Board approved the reconstitution of the Audit Committee, Stake Holders Relationship Committee and the Nomination Remuneration Committee.
